method: Independent Python 3 standard-library tuple construction, compact json.dumps(ensure_ascii=False), UTF-8, hashlib.sha256. No protocol implementation imports.
notes: Immutable expected bytes for review; never regenerate expected values to make an implementation pass.
All account/provider/service identifiers and definition digests are synthetic. They have no admission, qualification, wallet, payment or deployment authority.
The fixed voidly.ai public URL prefix is required by the existing public DTO contract; every slug is synthetic and no URL was contacted.
V1 historical means a synthetic vector of the retained V1 wire format, not a real historical account or publication.
The V1 save intentionally omits its optional projectionDigest; the absent slot remains absent in its canonical tuple.
The two-service and reordered vectors change only order-dependent inputs and digests; their owner, operation key, counters and labels match.

The maximum vector fills all service reference identifiers to 128 characters, text fields to their character limits, and includes four-byte Unicode, quotes, backslashes, U+2028 and U+2029. It is a maximum-member stress case, not proof of every possible encoding bound.
ownerReadEnvelope contains both revision and publication config to make response size reproducible.
Expected canonical strings are actual strings, not object-key-sorted JSON; no Unicode normalization is performed.
v2-one omits the optional public-entry checkout field. All other V2 public examples emit the exact null/not-open/not-asserted shape. Neither form claims purchase readiness.
